# netbox_virtual_circuit_termination (Data Source)

Retrieves a single virtual circuit termination from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_termination" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "virtual_circuit_termination_id" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_circuit_termination.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the virtual circuit termination.
- `interface_id` (Number) The ID of the interface associated with the virtual circuit termination.
- `role` (String) The role of the virtual circuit termination.
- `virtual_circuit_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual circuit associated with the virtual circuit termination.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the virtual circuit termination.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the virtual circuit termination, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual circuit termination.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the virtual circuit termination.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
